title: Prospect research
description: Research one B2B prospect (company + person), write a dossier to Notion, and leave a skeleton outreach email as a Gmail draft.

domain.description: Company website domain, e.g. "acme.com". Helps disambiguate and speeds up company research.

contactName.description: The influencer-marketing contact's full name, if known.

contactTitle.description: The contact's job title, e.g. "Head of Influencer Marketing".

linkedinUrl.description: Direct LinkedIn profile URL for the contact, if known.

notionPageUrl.description: URL of an existing Notion prospect page to update, if this prospect already has one. Omit to create a new dossier page.
